title.original: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
title.zh: MemGPT：迈向操作系统式大语言模型
title.en: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems

inclusion_reason.zh: MemGPT 将分层记忆、虚拟上下文和中断控制实现为可复用智能体运行时，奠定长期状态管理研究的基础。
inclusion_reason.en: MemGPT implements hierarchical memory, virtual context, and interrupt-driven control as a reusable agent runtime, grounding later research on long-lived state management.

abstract.zh: MemGPT 借鉴操作系统虚拟内存，在有限上下文窗口内管理快慢记忆层，并通过数据移动提供超出窗口的持久上下文。
abstract.en: MemGPT borrows virtual-memory ideas to manage fast and slow memory tiers within a limited context window, moving data to provide persistent context beyond that window.

problem.zh: 固定上下文窗口使大文档分析和多会话对话丢失历史；简单截断或一次性检索无法持续决定哪些状态应留在活动上下文。
problem.en: Fixed context windows lose history in large-document analysis and multi-session chat; truncation or one-shot retrieval cannot continually decide what belongs in active context.

approach.zh: 系统把上下文视为快速内存，把外部存储视为慢速内存，由模型触发读写和换页，并利用中断协调自身与用户的控制流。
approach.en: The system treats the context window as fast memory and external storage as slow memory, lets the model trigger reads, writes, and paging, and uses interrupts to coordinate control flow.

system_design.zh: 记忆管理器维护不同层级及其元数据，LLM 通过函数接口执行换入换出，控制器在 token 压力或事件发生时触发中断与上下文重组。
system_design.en: A memory manager maintains tiers and metadata, the LLM invokes functions to page state in or out, and a controller triggers interrupts and context reconstruction under token pressure or events.

key_results.zh: 摘要显示 MemGPT 能处理远超底层窗口的大文档，并构建跨多会话记忆、反思和演化的对话智能体。
key_results.en: The abstract shows MemGPT analyzing documents beyond the underlying context window and supporting conversational agents that remember, reflect, and evolve across sessions.

limitations.zh: 由模型自主换页可能遗漏关键事实或污染长期记忆，外部存储还引入隐私、延迟与一致性问题；评测领域较少。
limitations.en: Model-directed paging can omit critical facts or contaminate long-term memory, while external storage adds privacy, latency, and consistency risks; evaluated domains are limited.

baselines: underlying LLM with a limited context window

notes.zh: 模型、任务、硬件、基线与指标仅转录自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未披露的表格和部署细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics are transcribed only from the official arXiv abstract; undisclosed tables and deployment details still require full-text audit.
